---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the app, API, tools or firmware build misbehaves
labels: bug
---

**What happened / what you expected**

**Ring and firmware** (SY01 + stock V2.1.4, or our custom build N from the status screen; "none" if you have no ring)

**Phone** (model, Android version)

**How to reproduce**

**Logs** (Developer mode -> console, or `adb logcat -s SmartRing`). Remove device addresses (MAC) and API tokens first.

**Is this a firmware-flashing problem?** If the ring does not boot or reconnect after an update, say so clearly and attach the
app log from the update attempt. Never paste firmware images.
